name: @yordan/design-system
description: AI-ready, repo-first design system for the blueprint portfolio. Source of truth: tokens/tokens.json + components/*/spec.md + css/components.css. See README.md.
//: `private: true` and no `publishConfig`: this is consumed by `file:`, never from a registry. `version` is still real — scripts/contract-diff.mjs enforces it against the committed contract in RELEASED.json, so a consumer pinning a range gets a semver promise a publish step would otherwise have to make. `exports` is the same statement the boundary gate makes: dist/ and css/ are published, everything else here is private, and a subpath not listed below is unreachable rather than merely undocumented. `assets/` is in `files` and NOT in `exports` on purpose — avatar.svg is fetched by URL from markup, never resolved as a module.

scripts.//test: Both gates build storybook-static when it is stale, serve it on an ephemeral port and drive @storybook/test-runner against it — no dev server, and no http-server/wait-on/concurrently. CI needs `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` first. NEITHER joins the root `npm run check`: that gate is offline, browser-free and dependency-light, and these two need Chromium. test:visual is REPORT-ONLY until 2026-09-01 — see .storybook/test-runner.js.
